constraint planning.brief_sections brief_sections_audiences_check CHECK (((cardinality(audiences) > 0) AND (audiences <@ ARRAY['viewer'::text, 'commenter'::text, 'round_host'::text, 'venue'::text, 'organizer'::text])))
